images.title: Reserve - Fuel Tank Locations
images.description: Map showing the locations of both fuel tank groups that must be marked on Reserve.

images.title: MS2000 Marker
images.description: Bring two MS2000 Markers, one for each group of fuel tanks.

images.title: First Fuel Tank Group
images.description: Find the red fuel tanks near the gas station on Reserve and place an MS2000 Marker.
images.objective_id: Mark the first group of fuel tanks with an MS2000 Marker on Reserve

images.title: Second Fuel Tank Group
images.description: Find the gray fuel tanks near the train station on Reserve and place an MS2000 Marker.
images.objective_id: Mark the second group of fuel tanks with an MS2000 Marker on Reserve
